title: mirabilis pumila
intro: Mirabilis pumila, commonly known as Dwarf four o'clock, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Nyctaginaceae family. The health benefits of Mirabilis pumila include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help in soothing skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis pumila include its use in traditional medicine for treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its application in modern medicine for its potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Mirabilis pumila include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential therapeutic applications.
